description: Curated Russian retrieval corpus (report-only, WP3). Same shape as retrieval.json: (query, claim) pairs plus distractors ingested into the same canon. Includes typo/morphology probes (misspelled or inflected query words) where character-trigram embeddings are expected to outperform whole-word hashing. Not part of the CI gate: used for comparative reports, e.g. VELANTRIM_EMBEDDER=hashing-trigram velantrim eval --lang ru.
